certificate_semantics.primary: absence from the released train split
certificate_semantics.conservative: absence from the union of released train, valid, and test splits
certificate_semantics.shortlists: reduced formula for strict matching; anonymous reduced stoichiometry and primitive site count for anonymous matching
certificate_semantics.scientific_test: pymatgen StructureMatcher fit or fit_anonymous; shortlist absence alone is used only for exhaustive composition absence
